description: This file defines a BudgetManager class responsible for handling budget-related operations within a project, including creating budgets, updating costs, retrieving budget info, resetting costs based on durations, and loading/saving budget data from local files or a hosted API. It manages user budgets, tracks costs, and communicates with external services via the litellm library.

classes.name: BudgetManager
classes.description: Main class managing user budgets, costs, and data persistence for a project.

methods.name: __init__( self, project_name: str, client_type: str = "local", api_base: Optional[str] = None, headers: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes a BudgetManager instance with project parameters and loads existing data.

methods.name: print_verbose(self, print_statement)
methods.description: Outputs verbose log messages if verbosity is enabled.

methods.name: load_data(self)
methods.description: Loads budget data from a local JSON file or a hosted API, depending on client type.

methods.name: create_budget( self, total_budget: float, user: str, duration: Optional[Literal["daily", "weekly", "monthly", "yearly"]] = None, created_at: float = time.time(), )
methods.description: Creates a new budget for a user with optional duration and timestamp.

methods.name: projected_cost(self, model: str, messages: list, user: str)
methods.description: Calculates the projected cost of a conversation based on message content and model.

methods.name: get_total_budget(self, user: str)
methods.description: Returns the total budget allocated to a user.

methods.name: update_cost( self, user: str, completion_obj: Optional[ModelResponse] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, input_text: Optional[str] = None, output_text: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Updates a user's current cost based on a completion or message exchange.

methods.name: get_current_cost(self, user)
methods.description: Retrieves the current accumulated cost for a user.

methods.name: get_model_cost(self, user)
methods.description: Retrieves the accumulated cost per model for a user.

methods.name: bool is_valid_user(self, user: str)
methods.description: Checks if a user exists in the budget data.

methods.name: reset_cost(self, user)
methods.description: Resets a user's current and model costs to zero.

methods.name: reset_on_duration(self, user: str)
methods.description: Resets a user's costs if the specified duration has elapsed since last update.

methods.name: update_budget_all_users(self)
methods.description: Iterates over all users and resets costs as needed based on durations.

methods.name: _save_data_thread(self)
methods.description: Triggers saving data asynchronously in a separate thread.

methods.name: save_data(self)
methods.description: Saves budget data either locally or via a hosted API.
